label: Cybersecurity Posture Pro
summary: Advanced cybersecurity posture review across identities, secrets, exposed services, TLS, software advisories, configuration drift and selected protection integrations. It correlates source-attributed evidence, tracks reviewed exceptions and produces scoped remediation proposals; scanner investigations, active incident response and DDoS orchestration remain separate workflows.
core_boundary: All essential security, tenant isolation, credential/MFA/session protections, host hardening, firewall policy, baseline protection, audit and local recovery remain in the free Core. Cybersecurity Posture adds comparative assessments and exception/evidence workflows, without a second policy authority, raw shell or entitlement-based relaxation of mandatory controls.
acceptance: Record subject, engine/package version, evidence source/time, freshness and applicability for every posture statement, including unknown and uncollected areas.
Assess identity/secret exposure, configuration drift, TLS and reachable-service policy through qualified bounded observations; do not equate an inventory with a vulnerability scan.

Scope optional advisory/WAF/file-integrity findings to the actual tenant/resource and compatible provider; coordinate with malware, response and DDoS modules without duplicating their case or execution authority.
Qualify check inputs, rate/resource budgets, redaction and permitted network/filesystem visibility against synthetic fixtures; refuse unrestricted scans or root inspection.
Bind remediation proposals to the owning Core use case, current permission, exact resource revision, meaningful diff and supported recovery procedure.
Exercise false positives, revoked actors, stale findings, exceptions and provider outages while keeping missing evidence distinct from secure or healthy status.
Preserve all mandatory baseline controls during disablement, expiry and provider loss; optional scores must never unlock a weaker security policy.
Make reviewed findings and permitted evidence exportable while Core audit, authorized baseline remediation and local incident/recovery access remain independent of this package.
